Exchange Online – Mailbox Overview

This report provides the most important metrics for all Exchange Online mailboxes in the selected tenant. It is well suited for customer reviews, storage analysis, licensing discussions, and identifying optimization potential across user, shared, and resource mailboxes.

The data is based on mailbox and usage information cached by CIPP. Storage values from Microsoft 365 usage reporting require the related reporting data to be available in the tenant.
